text:
erin: Heads-up — we saw a spike of customer 429s this AM right after the SDK micro-patch that added client-side routing hints. stacktrace pasted below. anyone else seeing this?

sam: saw it too. Symptoms: requests routed to unexpected quota buckets, then throttle. Repro in staging.

nina: console telemetry shows a consistent mismatch: SDK sent header x-redwood-route with value 'null' while gateway resolved a normal route_id. looks like serialization change.

leo: confirmed in py: our ujson encode used by the header helper turns empty string -> null. TS lib does something similar when optional field is undefined. quick mitigation: stop sending header when falsy. patch in flight.

erin: We need a short-term patch + longer-term guardrails: gateway should ignore literal string 'null', SDKs should not emit invalid tokens, and console needs a column to correlate client raw header with resolved route for debugging.

sam: rollout proposal:
1) emergency hotfix to python & typescript SDKs to omit falsy header (PRs now).
2) gateway fallback to treat 'null' or 'None' (string) as absent for routing decision.
3) add 'client_route_raw' to quota dashboards to make these incidents triageable.
4) add telemetry tag `shim=v1` for this fix so we can filter.

nina: QA: will add synthetic tests for both empty-string and explicit 'null' payloads hitting routing. Also create an alert rule on route_mismatch_rate > 1% over 5m.

leo: PR links: py: https://git.redwood/py-sdk/pull/12345, ts: https://git.redwood/ts-sdk/pull/67890. Gateway tweak filed: ENG-1122 and marked P0.

qa-bot: staging run completed at 1735557785 — synthetic route-mismatch test passed after SDK patches applied.

erin: Nice. Follow-ups: update SDK migration docs to call out header semantics, announce in #sdk-updates, and add console schema for nullable vs missing header. Also we should add a small lint in SDK CI that flags sending literal 'null' or 'None' as header values.

sam: Will draft the announcement. assigning follow-ups: nina -> tests & alert, leo -> gateway change, sam -> announcement/ops note. Closing this thread when prod stable. :thumbsup:

---
